note: Reference-only GLSL ES 3.00 fragment shaders (validated by the port, runnable verbatim in WebGL2). This file describes each shader's textures and uniforms for the review app's shader viewer; subjects come from previews/previews.json.
vertex: Full-screen quad. vUV = (0,0) at the top-left texel of the source image, (1,1) at the bottom-right; textures are sampled with NEAREST filtering and no premultiplied alpha.

textures.indexed: the subject's indexed PNG (sheet/atlas) decoded to RGBA: full-bright palette, index 31 transparent on sprites
textures.highlight_mask: the subject's 1-bit highlight mask PNG (white where index 16..24)
textures.bank: sampler2DArray built from the subject's previews/*_light*.png in ascending level order

daynight_bank.glsl.title: Day/night from the prebaked per-level bank

modes.label: fade_down / fade_normal

param.label: i (one weight for r, g, b)

modes.rule: uWeight = (i, i, i); the game steps i by 5 per tick (fmain2.c:623-629)

modes.label: intro zoom (screen_size)
modes.rule: y = x*5/8 (integer); uWeight = (2y-40, 2y-70, 2y-100); the intro runs x = 0..160 then 156..0 in steps of 4 (fmain.c:1199, 1209)

compare.fade_page: previews/<subject>_light<uLightlevel>.png when uLightlevel is a baked level and the jewel is off; <subject>_jewel_light000.png when the jewel is on at level 0
compare.bank: the baked layer when uLevel01 sits exactly on one
compare.full_bright: <subject>_light180.png when all weights are 100 and the jewel is off (the original palette)
